basics.name: Eugene Opoku
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer · AI Product Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer who designs, builds, and ships complete production web and mobile products end-to-end — payments, escrow, real-time messaging, and AI integrations — using TypeScript, React/Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Founder of For You Commerce; comfortable owning a product from architecture to deployment and working remotely across any time zone.

1.title: Founder & Full-Stack Engineer
description: Architected and built a social commerce platform end-to-end as a solo engineer using Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL — covering vendor storefronts, escrow-based payments, and real-time messaging.
Onboarded 20 vendors and 67 early users during pre-launch while iterating toward public release.
Own the full lifecycle: product strategy, system architecture, implementation, deployment, and infrastructure.

3.title: AI Training Data Specialist (Remote)
description: Annotated and curated image datasets for computer-vision model training on a fully remote, asynchronous team.
Sustained high-volume daily throughput (12+ hour workdays) while maintaining strict quality-assurance standards for training data integrity.
Gained first-hand insight into the data pipeline behind production ML systems.

1.details: Developed strong analytical, research, and communication skills applied daily to software engineering and product design.

2.title: SaaS Afric
2.description: Building developer infrastructure and tools for African SaaS founders to launch, process global payments, and scale internationally.
